plugins.name: ts-conventions
plugins.description: TypeScript documentation and code style conventions: installs the rule files into a target repo, and audits existing JSDoc against them.

plugins.name: codebase-recon
plugins.description: Diagnose an unfamiliar or legacy codebase from its git history before reading source files, and produce a prioritized reading list.

plugins.name: effect-xray
plugins.description: Behavior-preserving useEffect refactor for React/TSX, run as a gate: every removal carries an explicit preservation claim, and risky ones are adversarially falsified before they ship.

plugins.name: table-driven-tuning
plugins.description: Move game balance out of code into data tables, and close the tuning loop with a validator, seeded headless simulation, bot metrics, and a committed baseline.

plugins.name: pike-rules
plugins.description: Rob Pike's 5 Rules of Programming as an always-on rule file: measure before optimizing, keep algorithms and data structures simple, and design the data first.
